name: Sleep clinic

pf.license.need: a state license for each sleep doctor and nurse practitioner; a sleep technologist's certificate where the state requires one; the sleep center's registration where the state's rules require it; a technologist who sets up a test or a mask at home only where the state allows it
pf.license.who: both: the center, and each clinician or technologist who sees patients
pf.license.ask: optional, for the owner's own page: each clinician's license number and the center's registration; nothing is needed to book
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up a license, certificate or training record; the owner keeps them current
pf.license.scope: a technologist sets up and runs a test; a sleep doctor reads it; Rosie never gives medical advice
pf.license.blocks: none from Rosie: no booking is held or refused because a license can't be read
pf.license.renewals: none kept by Rosie: the owner keeps the renewal dates
pf.license.insurance: the owner's own liability insurance; Rosie never verifies it
pf.license.background: the center's own background checks for staff who go into a patient's home, where its rules or the state require them; Rosie never verifies them
pf.license.telehealth: a video follow-up counts as at the center; the clinician's license for the patient's state applies

pf.services.shape: sleep clinic: consults and follow-ups with a named sleep doctor or the next open one; an overnight sleep study at the center (a stay from the evening to the morning, with a technologist); a home sleep test kit picked up at the desk and returned by mail; CPAP mask fittings at the center or at home; a video follow-up counts as at the center
pf.services.examples: the example center's own prices and lengths, not a standard

list.name: New patient sleep consult
list.price: billed to the health plan; self-pay from the center's price list (example: $230 self-pay)
list.after: the plan is billed; any share is billed after the plan pays
list.note: the first consult: a sleep history on the secure page only

list.name: Follow-up sleep visit
list.note: a result is read at this visit, never named in a text

list.name: Overnight sleep study
list.price: billed to the plan; self-pay from the center's price list (example: $1,150 self-pay)
list.length: a stay from 8pm to 6am at the center
list.note: a child's study needs a parent or guardian to stay overnight; the stay is named on the booking

list.name: Home sleep test kit (picked up at the desk, returned by mail)
list.note: the kit is returned in its box by mail; a kit returned to the desk is checked in at once

list.name: CPAP mask fitting at the center
list.after: as above; a self-pay fitting is paid at the desk
list.note: the mask is fitted to the patient's own face with a technologist

list.name: Video follow-up visit
list.price: $85 self-pay (example), paid in full when booking
list.where: by video (counts as at the center)
list.note: the code is read out at the start, as for any visit at the center

list.name: Home sleep test set-up
list.price: billed to the plan its own way; $160 self-pay (example)
list.length: 40 min at the place; a 2-hour arrival window in the morning
list.before: nothing taken (the bill after), or a card saved
list.after: the center bills the plan its own way, or the bill is texted for a self-pay patient
list.note: a technologist sets up the kit at the bedside and shows how to wear it; no test result is read at home

list.name: CPAP mask fitting at home
list.price: billed to the plan its own way; $160 self-pay (example)
list.length: 40 min at the place; a 2-hour arrival window in the morning
list.note: the patient must be there; a homebound patient who doesn't answer gets a safety check first

pf.services.capacity: rooms at the center (example 3 study rooms, one per night, and 2 exam rooms), each a 15-minute slot for a follow-up or a night for a study; home visits by route, a set number each morning
pf.services.online: video follow-ups only where the state allows them for that care; results are on the secure page
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the patient must be there
pf.services.walkIns: no walk-in line; a cancelled study night is offered to the next patient on the list

beforeTimes: the kind of visit (new consult, follow-up, overnight study, home test kit, mask fitting, home set-up)
whether it's a video follow-up (counts as at the center)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a child's overnight study: the child's age, and a parent who stays overnight
for a home visit: the town and whether the patient can come to the door
afterTime: a note for the technologist: a past faint, or a bed partner who needs a say
for a home visit: the address, parking and any gate code
securePage: the sleep history (on the secure page only)
date of birth (every study is matched to the patient by two details)
medicines that matter, only where the study asks (sedating ones)
for an overnight study: who picks up a child in the morning
who may get the results: the patient; a parent or guardian for a child
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child (who stays overnight for a child's study); a bed partner may not book for the patient

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, or a stroke sign (face drooping, arm weakness, or trouble speaking)

goOn.words: a near-crash from falling asleep at the wheel, or a fall during the night
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the sleep doctor is told that day, and the nurse line calls within the hour

goOn.words: a question about a result or a medicine
goOn.what: never answered by Rosie: the center's nurse line; the sleep doctor is told that day

goOn.words: feels unsafe at home or with a partner
goOn.what: the family-violence line's words come first, then the booking goes on privately; the team is told that day, with no detail in any text

pf.safety.fasting: none; the study's own instructions (no caffeine or alcohol for the day, the usual medicines unless the sleep doctor says otherwise) go in the reminder
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm → call 911 or 988, and no booking

steps.name: A sleep history for a new patient
steps.when: on the secure page before the first consult
steps.result: done: booked; not done: the desk asks once, then the consult waits

steps.name: A parent's OK for a child's overnight study
steps.when: on the secure page before the study, with the overnight stay named
steps.result: OK on file: booked; no OK: no study

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: by the desk before the visit
steps.result: covered, part covered (the share shown), or not covered (self-pay); where the plan's rules require it, a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit

steps.name: The home test kit's pick-up and return
steps.when: at the desk when the kit is picked up; the box returned by mail
steps.result: returned: the test is read; not returned: the sleep doctor is told, and a new kit is offered with no charge

pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: a night's bag, pajamas, the usual medicines, photo ID and the plan card; for a study: no caffeine or alcohol for the day, and the sleep center's own instructions; for a home visit, clear the bedside

pf.visit.checkIn: at the desk: the code, then photo ID and the plan card checked against the secure page; an overnight study checks in in the evening with a technologist; a home visit: the code at the door, then photo ID
pf.visit.changes: the sleep doctor adds a follow-up or a mask fitting: priced first, with the self-pay price shown; nothing else is sold at a visit
pf.visit.cantGoAhead: no ID; a child's overnight study with no parent staying (no study, no fee); the patient feels faint or is unwell during a study: the study stops and a new study is booked with no charge
pf.visit.done: the code, then DONE from the technologist; the sleep doctor reads the result; results go to the patient's secure page; Rosie keeps only booking records
pf.visit.rejected: a home test that can't be read: a free new kit by mail, offered by the secure page
pf.visit.dropOff: a kit returned to the desk is checked in at once with the patient's two details

pf.money.before: a consult, follow-up or fitting takes nothing when booking; an overnight study takes nothing when booking and is billed to the plan; a video follow-up is paid in full; a card may be saved for a late-cancel fee only if the owner turns it on
pf.money.insurance: health plans: only the plan's name before times; member details on the secure page; the center bills the plan; the patient's share is billed after the plan pays (Rosie texts the bill)
pf.money.thirdParty: none: an employer or a family member is never the payer through Rosie
pf.money.estimate: a self-pay patient gets a written price estimate before an overnight study, where the rules require it
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.fees: a late-cancel fee (example $25) only with a saved card, and never for a fee-free patient; a home visit's visit fee is billed after, and only if agreed when booking
pf.money.refunds: the owner decides refunds; Rosie never refunds on its own

pf.messages.never: the sleep history, test names, results, medicines, the child's details, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the center's name, the day, the time and the place
pf.messages.staffTexts: the owner and staff get the patient's initials, the time and the room; no health details
pf.messages.results: a text says only 'your results are ready on the secure page'
pf.messages.minors: a child's texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: a sleep doctor's state license; a technologist's certificate where the state requires one; the center keeps its own record (optional, never looked up by Rosie)
pf.staff.skills: in-lab sleep studies, home sleep tests, CPAP mask fitting, pediatric sleep studies, Spanish
pf.staff.supervision: the sleep doctor reads every study; a new technologist works under a senior one until signed off
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs new patients, refunds and any study price
pf.staff.standIn: a patient may ask for a named doctor; the next open one with the skill takes it otherwise; an overnight study stays with its night team
pf.staff.away: only technologists cleared for home visits go to a patient's home

pf.rules.privacy: a health privacy agreement (a business associate agreement) is signed before going live; health details only on the secure page
pf.rules.records: study records are the center's own, kept as long as the state's rules require; Rosie keeps only booking records
pf.rules.consent: a child's overnight study needs a parent or guardian's OK on the secure page; the stay is named on the booking
pf.rules.showFacts: the center's name and address; no license claim unless the owner gives it as the owner's own word
pf.rules.results: results go to the patient's secure page within the time the health privacy rules set; a child's results go to the parent or guardian
pf.rules.reviews: a rating is never asked for health work (sensitive); any reply never confirms the person was a patient

pf.edges.fasting: none; the study's own instructions go in the reminder
pf.edges.noOrder: a referral the plan needs: the desk asks the plan while the patient waits, or the visit moves with no fee
pf.edges.rejected: a home test that can't be read: a free new kit
pf.edges.critical: a result that needs same-day care: the sleep doctor calls the patient, never a text
pf.edges.faint: a patient feels faint or is unwell during a study: the study stops, the patient lies down, 911 if hurt; the owner is told with no health detail
pf.edges.kids: a child's overnight study: a parent or guardian stays overnight
pf.edges.mobile: a homebound patient doesn't come to the door: the technologist calls, then the contact on the booking; the owner decides a welfare check; no fee while the patient's safety is unknown
pf.edges.results: results to the patient, or a parent for a child; never to the payer
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
